options.content:
- Use Cases: Leave the issue key empty to list linked pull requests in the selected time range. Enter a key such as DEVO-446 to show only that issue. Only issues with status DONE are included. Pull requests in gotickets/maverick-api are left out.
- Time range: a released pull request is included when its production time is in the range. A pull request that is not in production yet is included when its merge time is in the range.
- Released to Production: the DORA production time (`project_pr_metrics.pr_deployed_date`) when DevLake has it, otherwise the first successful PRODUCTION deployment of the merge commit. Empty means that pull request is not in production yet.
- Release Tag: the git tag on the deployed commit (`refs` where `ref_type` is TAG). The `refs/tags/` prefix is removed. The tag links to https://github.com/<repo>/releases/tag/<tag>. The tag and the deployment link stay empty when that deployed commit has no tag, or when DevLake did not store a deployment for the pull request.
- Issue links open https://scoretickets.atlassian.net/browse/<issue key>.
- Data Sources Required: Jira, GitHub, a deployment source (Jenkins/ArgoCD/webhook). Issue-to-PR links come from `pull_request_issues`; PRs whose title, branch, or description does not reference the issue key will not appear.

panels.description: Counts linked issues in the selected time range. With a key, this is when that issue's last merged pull request reached production, if that release is in the range.

targets.rawSql:
with _pr_release as (
  select
    ppm.id as pr_id,
    min(ppm.pr_deployed_date) as released_date,
    min(ppm.deployment_commit_id) as deployment_commit_id
  from project_pr_metrics ppm
  where ppm.pr_deployed_date is not null
  group by ppm.id
),
_merge_prod as (
  select
    d.commit_sha,
    min(d.finished_date) as released_date
  from cicd_deployment_commits d
  where d.result = 'SUCCESS'
    and upper(d.environment) = 'PRODUCTION'
    and d.commit_sha is not null
    and d.commit_sha != ''
  group by d.commit_sha
),
_issue_prs as (
  select
    i.issue_key,
    concat('https://scoretickets.atlassian.net/browse/', i.issue_key) as issue_url,
    i.title as issue_title,
    i.status as issue_status,
    r.name as repo,
    pr.pull_request_key,
    pr.url as pr_url,
    pr.title as pr_title,
    pr.status as pr_status,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.merge_commit_sha,
    coalesce(rel.released_date, mp.released_date) as released_date,
    cdc.name as deployment,
    cdc.url as deployment_url,
    (
      select group_concat(distinct replace(t.name, 'refs/tags/', '') order by t.name separator ', ')
      from refs t
      where t.commit_sha = coalesce(cdc.commit_sha, pr.merge_commit_sha)
        and t.ref_type = 'TAG'
    ) as release_tag
  from issues i
    join pull_request_issues pri on pri.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_requests pr on pr.id = pri.pull_request_id and pr.base_repo_id not in (select id from repos where name in ('gotickets/public-web-client', 'gotickets/maverick-api'))
    left join repos r on r.id = pr.base_repo_id
    left join _pr_release rel on rel.pr_id = pr.id
    left join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on cdc.id = rel.deployment_commit_id
    left join _merge_prod mp on mp.commit_sha = pr.merge_commit_sha
  where
    i.id like 'jira:%'
    and i.status = 'DONE'
    and (
      '${issue_key}' = ''
      or i.issue_key = upper(trim('${issue_key}'))
    )
)
select
  case
    when count(*) = 0 then 'None in this range'
    when '${issue_key}' = '' then concat(count(distinct issue_key), ' issues')
    when sum(merged_date is not null) = 0 then 'No merged PRs yet'
    when sum(merged_date is not null and released_date is null) > 0
      then concat('Not fully released (', sum(released_date is not null), '/', sum(merged_date is not null), ' merged PRs)')
    else date_format(max(released_date), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i UTC')
  end as 'Released'
from _issue_prs
where (
  (released_date is not null and $__timeFilter(released_date))
  or (released_date is null and merged_date is not null and $__timeFilter(merged_date))
)

panels.title: Released

panels.description: Linked pull requests in the selected time range. Enter an issue key to show only that issue. Release Tag is the git tag on the deployed commit. Empty Released to Production means that pull request is not in production yet.

targets.rawSql:
with _pr_release as (
  select
    ppm.id as pr_id,
    min(ppm.pr_deployed_date) as released_date,
    min(ppm.deployment_commit_id) as deployment_commit_id
  from project_pr_metrics ppm
  where ppm.pr_deployed_date is not null
  group by ppm.id
),
_merge_prod as (
  select
    d.commit_sha,
    min(d.finished_date) as released_date
  from cicd_deployment_commits d
  where d.result = 'SUCCESS'
    and upper(d.environment) = 'PRODUCTION'
    and d.commit_sha is not null
    and d.commit_sha != ''
  group by d.commit_sha
),
_issue_prs as (
  select
    i.issue_key,
    concat('https://scoretickets.atlassian.net/browse/', i.issue_key) as issue_url,
    i.title as issue_title,
    i.status as issue_status,
    r.name as repo,
    pr.pull_request_key,
    pr.url as pr_url,
    pr.title as pr_title,
    pr.status as pr_status,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.merge_commit_sha,
    coalesce(rel.released_date, mp.released_date) as released_date,
    cdc.name as deployment,
    cdc.url as deployment_url,
    (
      select group_concat(distinct replace(t.name, 'refs/tags/', '') order by t.name separator ', ')
      from refs t
      where t.commit_sha = coalesce(cdc.commit_sha, pr.merge_commit_sha)
        and t.ref_type = 'TAG'
    ) as release_tag
  from issues i
    join pull_request_issues pri on pri.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_requests pr on pr.id = pri.pull_request_id and pr.base_repo_id not in (select id from repos where name in ('gotickets/public-web-client', 'gotickets/maverick-api'))
    left join repos r on r.id = pr.base_repo_id
    left join _pr_release rel on rel.pr_id = pr.id
    left join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on cdc.id = rel.deployment_commit_id
    left join _merge_prod mp on mp.commit_sha = pr.merge_commit_sha
  where
    i.id like 'jira:%'
    and i.status = 'DONE'
    and (
      '${issue_key}' = ''
      or i.issue_key = upper(trim('${issue_key}'))
    )
)
select
  issue_key as 'Issue',
  issue_url,
  issue_title as 'Issue Title',
  issue_status as 'Issue Status',
  repo as 'Repo',
  concat('#', pull_request_key) as 'PR',
  pr_url,
  pr_title as 'PR Title',
  pr_status as 'PR Status',
  merged_date as 'Merged',
  released_date as 'Released to Production',
  release_tag as 'Release Tag',
  case when release_tag is null or release_tag = '' or instr(release_tag, ',') > 0 or repo is null then null else concat('https://github.com/', repo, '/releases/tag/', release_tag) end as release_tag_url,
  deployment as 'Deployment',
  deployment_url,
  (
    select min(d.finished_date)
    from cicd_deployment_commits d
    where d.commit_sha = _issue_prs.merge_commit_sha
      and d.result = 'SUCCESS'
  ) as 'First Deploy of Merge Commit (any env)'
from _issue_prs
where (
  (released_date is not null and $__timeFilter(released_date))
  or (released_date is null and merged_date is not null and $__timeFilter(merged_date))
)
order by released_date is null, released_date desc, merged_date desc
limit 500
